categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P, modifies headers synchronization handling in src/net_processing.cpp and tests in test/functional/p2p_initial_headers_sync.py.
categories.rationale: Fixes an indefinite headers synchronization stall during IBD when an inbound or manual peer returns empty headers. In p2p, liveness and ensuring 'nothing gets stuck' is a core priority, and as issue #34096 demonstrates, a node can currently stall indefinitely on an addnode peer despite having other synced peers available.
